name: assetpanda/page-faq-hub
title: AP Page Faq Hub
description: Help-centre FAQ for /faq/: a sticky topic list with question counts and an instant search beside topic groups (each an h2) of questions (h3) that open in place; on phones the topics become a sideways chip row over the search. Answers take paragraphs, bulleted and numbered lists, **bold** and [label](url) links. One FAQPage JSON-LD for every question. Search, topic highlight and the empty state are behaviour.js; without it every question shows and opens on click. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
